## D — Accuracy and source controls for Preparing to drive and driver factors
The preparing to drive and driver factors facts are authored from the selected official physical pages and preserve the actor, triggering condition and exceptions described there.
Source confidence is high for page fidelity; current legal applicability is limited by the old edition and recorded freshness debt.
Image-only information has not been converted into unsupported facts; any diagram-dependent learning surface needs its own evidence review.
The preaccept fact-check receipt is same-model review only; independent coverage and fact QA remain pending.
Historical and undated crash-statistic callouts are retained as source-currentness debt instead of stable learner facts (verify PA-FACTORS-HISTORICAL-STATS).
The alcohol crash-risk comparison spans a physical-page break and is withheld rather than cited incompletely to one page (verify PA-FACTORS-SPLIT-RISK).
The handbook's help-service contact details require current official confirmation before learner display (verify PA-FACTORS-HELP-CONTACT).
Source health descriptions and alcohol-processing comparisons are handbook study material; individual clinical applicability is not established by this extraction.

corpus_stability.reason: The issuer currently links the PUB 95 (4-21) handbook; no frequent-rewrite evidence is asserted. Edition age and absent effective date remain accuracy debt in part A.

verification_debt.claim_text: Quantitative safety callouts on physical35–38 include2017 seat-belt data, unperioded distraction/alcohol/death statistics,2013–2014 drug survey data and illustrative individual BAC estimates; preserve as historical source evidence, not current general learner rules.
The .04 BAC versus no-alcohol crash-risk comparison and its2–7 multiplier start on physical37 and finish on38; no single-page complete claim is available under the one-page-per-fact constraint.
Physical38 lists PA Get Help Now as1-800-662-HELP(4357), staffed24/7; current official availability and routing are unverified, so no stable contact fact is emitted.
